data.name: Saya
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘sa’ah’ meaning moon, Saya is a name that embodies calmness, tranquility and serenity. In Islamic culture, the moon is a symbol of peace and the passing of time. The name Saya is an ode to the soothing power of the moon.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the inner peace and tranquility that comes from connecting with the divine. The moon is a symbol of the divine feminine and the nurturing, maternal aspects of God. Saya is a reminder to seek inner peace and to be guided by the wisdom of the moon.
data.numerology_meaning: Symbolizes new beginnings, independence, and self-reliance. It is a number of creation, initiation and manifestation. The number one is a powerful number in numerology and represents the drive, determination, and willpower to succeed.
